fields.label: ITC Eligible
fields.description: Checked: this tax amount is claimable input tax credit and posts to the category's GST Input account. Unchecked: it is a blocked/non-claimable credit (Sec 17(5) or similar) and is added into the asset's capitalized cost instead.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Computed as Rate % of the Asset's Taxable Value. Recalculated on save.

fields.label: Account Head
fields.description: Optional override. If left blank, ITC-eligible lines use the category's GST Input Account and non-eligible lines have no separate account (folded into Fixed Asset Account).
